chunks: Whoever deals with people fairly from himself is accepted as a judge for others.

key_terms.لِغَيْرِهِ: for others, in settling their matters

ai.seo_question: What quality makes a person worthy of being accepted as a judge over others?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that true fairness begins with holding oneself to justice in one’s dealings with others. A person who is equitable with people earns the trust and acceptance needed to judge between others.
